Name: Longer Day
Author: iqcp1
Description:
The most common complaint in Stardew is that the day ends before you're done.
This mod stretches the day out so you can actually finish your chores.

FEATURES
- Press F8 to cycle the day length: normal -> 2x -> 3x -> 4x -> back to normal.
- Press F9 to freeze the clock entirely.
- Optionally freeze time automatically indoors, in the mines, or outdoors.
- An on-screen message tells you the current setting every time it changes.
- Your choice is saved automatically and restored next time you play.

CONFIGURATION
Edit config.json in the mod folder to change the hotkeys, the day lengths, or
which places freeze time. Any list of lengths works, not just 2/3/4.

NOTES
- Festivals and cutscenes are left alone; the game controls the clock there.
- Safe to add to an existing save, and safe to remove at any time.

INSTALL
1. Install SMAPI.
2. Unzip this into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Run the game using SMAPI.

Want the opposite? See my "Faster Time" mod, which speeds the clock up
instead. The two are completely separate and can be installed together.
